sentences.text:
No. 05.10.2024  05.
 1.
The petitioner is an accused in connection with Harichandanpur P.S. Case No.73 of 2019 corresponding to Special Case No.149/50 of 2022-19 for the offences punishable under Sections 366/376(2)(n)/417 of the IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act pending in the Court of the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Keonjhar.

2. The petitioner is aggrieved by the order dated 09.04.2024 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge under POCSO Act, Keonjhar in Special Case No.149/50 of 2022-19, whereby his bail application has been rejected.
3.
Learned counsel for the State submits that, in the present case, the victim lady has not yet been examined by the trial Court.
4. I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail at this stage.
However, liberty is granted to the petitioner to renew his bail plea before the trial Court after the victim is examined by the trial Court.
5. The learned trial court is directed to examine the victim-prosecutrix in the present case preferentially as the first witness over all other formal witnesses.
Thereafter, the petitioner may renew his bail plea before the trial Court.
If such bail application is filed by the petitioner before the trial Court, the same shall be considered on the basis of the materials available on record.
